problem:
Compute $P(2<X<8)$ given that the random variable $X$ has the probability density function

$$
f(x)={\begin{aligned}\frac{1}{50}x,\, & 0\le x\le 10, \\ 0,\, & \text{otherwise.}\end{aligned}
$$
worked_solution:
If a continuous random variable $X$ has the probability density function $f(x),$ then 

$$
P(a<X<b)={\int }_{a}^{b}f(x)\,\text{d}x.
$$

So, in our case, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}P(2<X<8) & ={\int }_{2}^{8}f(x)\,\text{d}x \\  & ={\int }_{2}^{8}\frac{1}{50}x\,\text{d}x \\  & ={[\frac{1}{100}{x}^{2}]}_{2}^{8} \\  & =\frac{3}{5}.\end{aligned}
$$
